QuestInfo.name: So Good, You Can't Resist
QuestInfo.0: In search of someone to acquire crunchy centipede legs. There may be people who've never tried fried centipede, but once you do, you can't have just one.

0.msg: Accept the [So Good, You Can't Resist] quest?

yes.0: This request asks for #i4009366:##t4009366# items off of #o9600309# monsters. Shouldn't be a problem for you, right? Obtaining 10 won't be easy, but if anyone can do it, it's you. You can find #o9600309# monsters at #m701102030#, but sometimes you have to wait a bit for them to show up. Good luck!\r\n
